name: 阿达·洛夫莱斯
bio_short: 英国数学家和作家，著名诗人拜伦勋爵的女儿。她被认为是历史上第一位计算机程序员。她为查尔斯·巴贝奇的“分析机”编写了著名的“注释”（`lovelace_first_program_1843`），其中包含的计算伯努利数的算法被公认为世界上第一个计算机程序。
bio_short_en: An English mathematician and writer, the daughter of Lord Byron. She is celebrated as the first computer programmer in history. Her famous 'Notes' on Charles Babbage's Analytical Engine (`lovelace_first_program_1843`) contained an algorithm for calculating Bernoulli numbers, widely recognized as the world's first computer program.
